name: Whitestone Market
summary: Whitestone Market is a well-regarded community shopping center in Cedar Park, Texas, serving the rapidly growing northern Austin suburbs. Managed by JLL Income Property Trust, this modern retail destination offers convenient access to everyday shopping and services with a strong 4.6-star rating from local residents.
demographics: Whitestone Market serves the affluent Cedar Park community in the Austin metropolitan area, attracting primarily middle to upper-middle income families with household incomes above the regional average. The trade area draws young professionals and growing families, typically aged 25-54, who value convenience and quality in their shopping experience. Visitors are predominantly homeowners in the rapidly developing northern Austin suburbs, seeking everyday necessities combined with specialty retail and dining options in a modern, accessible setting.
description: Whitestone Market is a contemporary shopping destination located in the heart of Cedar Park, Texas, strategically positioned along East Whitestone Boulevard in one of Austin's fastest-growing suburban communities. Developed and managed by JLL Income Property Trust, this well-maintained retail center exemplifies modern community-focused retail design, offering residents convenient access to essential services and quality shopping experiences. The center operates daily from 9:00 AM to 8:00 PM, providing flexible hours that accommodate the busy schedules of Cedar Park's professional and family-oriented population. With an impressive 4.6-star rating from over 100 Google reviews, Whitestone Market has established itself as a trusted neighborhood gathering place. The property represents JLL Income Property Trust's commitment to investing in stabilized, grocery-anchored retail assets in high-growth markets, serving the thriving northern Austin corridor with its mix of national retailers and local businesses.
